question: What voice settings parameters can I pass to the text-to-speech API endpoint?
ground_truth: When generating speech with ElevenLabs, you can adjust voice settings through the voice_settings object in the request body. Available settings include: stability (number) - controls how consistent the voice sounds; similarity_boost (number) - corresponds to 'Clarity + Similarity Enhancement' in the web app; style (number) - adjusts the speaking style; speed (number) - controls speech speed; and use_speaker_boost (boolean) - enables speaker enhancement. These settings are optional and have default values that can be retrieved via the GET /v1/voices/settings/default endpoint.

correctness: Should mention style and speed settings
